answer.origin: Fox News Digital, reporting by Amanda Macias, published 2026-07-01. The growth forecast is attributed to Corning CEO Wendell Weeks; its stated horizon is “over the coming years.”
answer.note: Weeks said Corning was in its fastest growth period and would “probably double” in size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part in the United States [incoming]. This is Corning’s forecast, not a forecast of NVIDIA’s own growth. The article attributes Corning’s optical-fiber demand to AI infrastructure needs, with a Corning planning supervisor saying glass optical fiber was needed to support that demand [item:e1, item:e4]. For NVIDIA, the more direct relevance is the reported partnership with Corning to build three advanced optical-manufacturing facilities in North Carolina and Texas. Fox said the project was expected to create more than 3,000 jobs and expand Corning’s U.S. optical-manufacturing capacity tenfold [item:e2, item:e5, item:e6]. These are reported project expectations, not evidence of NVIDIA’s purchase volume or a completed capacity increase. The article also reports that Wistron was establishing Texas AI-supercomputer manufacturing operations for NVIDIA, but gives no quantified capacity or timing [item:e7]. Taken together, the claims provide a demand and manufacturing-ecosystem signal for NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure, conditional on the reported projects proceeding; they do not establish NVIDIA revenue, orders, or direct obligations.
limitations: The article does not disclose the Corning partnership’s commercial terms, funding responsibilities, NVIDIA purchase commitments, or expected optical-fiber volumes.
The report gives no completion or commissioning dates for Corning’s facilities or timing for the expected capacity expansion and jobs.
The Wistron report does not specify the Texas operation’s production capacity, start date, or NVIDIA order volumes.
Weeks’s “probably double” forecast has no defined measure of company size, baseline, or more precise time horizon.
follow_up: Check NVIDIA and Corning announcements and filings for the partnership’s terms, NVIDIA’s role or purchase commitments, facility schedules, and capacity ramp milestones.
Check Corning filings and subsequent results for optical-fiber demand, realized capacity additions, and hiring against the reported expectations.
Check NVIDIA and Wistron disclosures for the Texas operation’s start date, production capacity, and any disclosed NVIDIA supply arrangements.
Check Corning’s later disclosures for the baseline, metric, and timeframe underlying Weeks’s projected doubling.
